notes.title: Exhibiting at the 2023 Steam Visual Novel Festival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41723128/68752a8e22afdf79eb240d25d52d26e13c10a3da.png[/img]

We will be showcasing the BL visual novel game "Rojiura Glory Hole" at the 2023 Steam Visual Novel Festival from August 7 to August 14.
During the event, the game will be available for purchase at an enticing 20% off its regular price.
Don't miss this opportunity to step into our world.

Let's spend this scorching summer together with a slightly eerie yet captivating BL masterpiece!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1845660/
